## Abderrahmane Wardi

I am a Professor of Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering Sciences, and a PhD candidate at the École Nationale Supérieure d'Arts et Métiers (ENSAM), Mohammed V University in Rabat, Morocco.

My academic activities combine **teaching**, **scientific research**, **embedded systems**, **signal processing**, **instrumentation**, and **automation**. My doctoral research extends these areas toward **biomedical applications**, with a focus on ECG signal processing and embedded artificial intelligence.

## Academic Interests

My main academic and research interests include:

- Electrical Engineering
- Industrial Engineering Sciences
- Embedded Systems
- Signal Processing
- Instrumentation and Measurement
- Automation and Control
- Biomedical Engineering
- ECG Signal Processing
- TinyML and Embedded Artificial Intelligence
- Internet of Things

## Teaching

My teaching activities focus on electrical engineering, industrial engineering sciences, instrumentation, signal acquisition, signal processing, and embedded systems.

## Research

My doctoral research focuses on intelligent biomedical systems, particularly the processing and classification of ECG signals using lightweight artificial intelligence models suitable for embedded devices. This work builds on a broader background in electrical engineering, embedded systems, and signal processing.

## Professional Development

I regularly participate in scientific conferences, training programs, workshops, and seminars related to teaching, research, engineering, and emerging technologies, in the fields of:

- Biomedical Engineering
- Artificial Intelligence
- Embedded Systems
- TinyML
- Signal Processing

## Academic Mission

My objective is to combine teaching, research, and engineering practice to develop accessible and efficient solutions in electrical engineering, embedded systems, and — through my doctoral work — intelligent biomedical instrumentation.
